title: MITM · two-block AES OWF key recovery

display.name: MITM · two-block AES OWF key recovery

target.description: Recover a full AES-256 key compatible with two fixed plaintext/ciphertext pairs in the source single-use AES OWF; costs include iterating the single-pair attack until the second pair is satisfied.

setting.key_relation: One fixed standard AES master key and its key schedule.
setting.plaintext_model: Two distinct predetermined plaintext blocks and their complete ciphertexts, under the same unknown master key.
assumptions: The source conversion repeats the SKP inversion until both public pairs are satisfied.

time.note: Table1 dagger and Section3.1: includes repetition for the second block.

memory.note: Same peak table as SKP subroutine.

preprocessing.note: Setup is included in total work unless separately stated.

success.description: The checked analysis gives an expected-work or filtering argument without a numeric probability for the complete named output event.

review.scope: PDF p.7 Table1; pp.9–12 SKP versus two-block OWF; p.40 AppendixC.3/Figure16.

evidence.locator: PDF p.7 Table1; pp.9–12 SKP versus two-block OWF; p.40 AppendixC.3/Figure16.
evidence.interpretation: Defining primary-text costs, output event and conditions checked together.

limitations: The complete named output probability is not quantified by the source.
